data.summary: I wrote intent/g4b/tech-spec.md. It keeps the best score in sessionStorage, with an in-memory fallback when storage is unavailable. The best is updated once when a run ends in a win or loss. It is shown as a `#best` HUD span next to Score and Lives. A new pure module `src/best.ts` holds the logic, `main.ts` and `index.html` get small edits, and tests are Vitest unit tests plus Playwright journeys. I also did not run anything, as this seat has no shell. A reader must know that the HUD placement is a changeable default, and that "session" means the tab session.
